messages.subject: job reactives for multicore::parallel
parts:
It would be great to be able to associate the jobs returned by parallel with another reactive - so that when parallel completes the reactive was fired.

This presumably could work by catching signals in the shiny runloop and looking up to see what reactives depend upon them

This would enable out-of-line work in shiny apps.  

yum

-Alex
